notes.title: Update Game 0.3.0!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! First of all I want to apologize for the long lack of updates
Game development will now continue outside of Early Access

In Update:

  New Person 3D model


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36856587/86c12217a3ecd292bf7e4976cbf0ba0834648218.png

 New crafting interface, now it is more intuitive

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36856587/835b6f98288f659045c90433a96732648b551d6c.png

 Quest system
New quests will be added gradually
 New main menu and pause menu
 New achievements
 New equipment slot with armor
 Some interface change
 New torch animations




In future updates:

 New game mechanics
 New map
 New animations
 More quests
 New items and weapons
 More optimization
 More transport
 And much more


Thanks to everyone who follows the development of the game!

notes.title: New Update 0.2!
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

New update available!

In Update:

 Achievements
 Added time in the game
 Added compass markers
 Fixed a problem with a magazine with 1 bullet
 After death, a marker with the distance to the backpack will appear on the compass
 AirDrop
 Added ability to change control settings
 Changed save system (need to start a new game, if still not working let me know)
 Increased cycle time of the day




In the next update is planned:
 Interface change
 Enlarged new map
 Quest system
 And much more

notes.title: Release Game in EA!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, very soon the game will be available for download.
Bugs are possible in the game, so if you want to get a fully working version I recommend waiting for the full release of the game.
You can share your suggestions for improving the game in the community or on the discord channel https://discord.gg/usetHMB
Welcome to Fallen Region!
